BRAND:MOVING PEACH

👗📣MOVING PEACH makes technical clothes for yoga and other types of fitness exercises.


🎉【Share】

Share your shopping experience，such as unboxing videos or wearing experiences, and post them on Tiktok, Instagram, or

YouTube to get an additional off.


🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥

🎉【Return】

If there has any issues with the product, please contact us freely, and we will do our best to service you. 💞💞


Please contact us before returning and make sure the product is new ：

No odors from being tried on, No stains, and the package and tags be intact, Not affect resale.

Thank you for your support!

🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥🍥

Size: S, M, L,XL

⭐️Details:

Designed for yoga, Pilates, dance, fitness & daily wear


Naturally breathable

U-neck design visually elongate the neckline

Wide shoulder strap, enhancing shock resistance and comfort﻿

Open back for ventilation and crossback straps for full range of movement

﻿ Built-in shelf bra with non-removable cups for added support and coverage

Fitted silhouette hits at natural waist

Tight fit contours your body


⭐️Package includes:

1 x Women's Sports Tank Top

This soft knit top features sweat-wicking fabric and a large mesh panel at the back to help you stay dry and cool. It's slightly tapered at the waist and has a curved hem for a comfortable fit. Nike Dri-FIT technology moves sweat away from your skin for quicker evaporation, helping you stay dry and comfortable. Large mesh panel on the back enhances breathability. Description:
Step back into the 1980s with our retro-inspired coat and pants set, featuring a long-sleeved zippered jacket with vibrant color block designs and high-waisted elastic trousers. Made from lightweight, breathable polyester, this outfit is comfortable, skin-friendly, and durable against fading and wear. Its bright colors and simple yet striking patterns capture the iconic 80s hip-hop style perfectly. Ideal for everyday wear, fitness, sports, hip-hop parties, disco nights, retro events, and halloween. Whether you're working out, running errands, or attending a themed party, this versatile set adds a stylish vintage touch to any occasion. A perfect gift for vintage fashion lovers!

product.highlights:
Vibrant 1980s retro style: eye-catching color-blocked zippered jacket and high-waisted trousers perfect for casual wear, themed parties, and hip-hop inspired looks.
Comfortable durable polyester: lightweight, breathable, and skin-friendly fabric that maintains bright colors wash after wash for long-lasting wear.
Minimalist yet bold design: clean lines with striking color blocks offer a timeless 80s aesthetic that blends retro charm with modern style.
Versatile wearability: ideal for gym sessions, retro-themed events, everyday streetwear, or even casual work environments.
Easy fit stylish comfort: long-sleeved jacket paired with elastic high-waisted trousers ensures a flattering and comfortable fit all day long.

page_json.description: Vibrant 1980s retro style: eye-catching color-blocked zippered jacket and high-waisted trousers perfect for casual wear, themed parties, and hip-hop inspired looks. Comfortable durable polyester: lightweight, breathable, and skin-friendly fabric that maintains bright colors wash after wash for long-lasting wear. Minimalist yet bold design: clean lines with striking color blocks offer a timeless 80s aesthetic that blends retro charm with modern style. Versatile wearability: ideal for gym sessions, retro-themed events, everyday streetwear, or even casual work environments. Easy fit stylish comfort: long-sleeved jacket paired with elastic high-waisted trousers ensures a flattering and comfortable fit all day long.Description:  Step back into the 1980s with our retro-inspired coat and pants set, featuring a long-sleeved zippered jacket with vibrant color block designs and high-waisted elastic trousers. Made from lightweight, breathable polyester, this outfit is comfortable, skin-friendly, and durable against fading and wear. Its bright colors and simple yet striking patterns capture the iconic 80s hip-hop style perfectly. Ideal for everyday wear, fitness, sports, hip-hop parties, disco nights, retro events, and halloween. Whether you're working out, running errands, or attending a themed party, this versatile set adds a stylish vintage touch to any occasion. A perfect gift for vintage fashion lovers!Item Name: Coat Pants SetMaterial: Polyester FiberStyle: Street StyleGender: UnisexSize Type: RegularNeck Type: Stand CollarSleeve Type: Long SleeveTops Length: RegularWaist Type: Mid-risePants Length: Long PantsFeatures: Color Block, Elastic Waist, DrawstringNotes: Please refer to our size chart and choose the right size. Due to the light and screen setting difference, the item's color may be slightly different from the pictures.Package Includes: 1 x Coat1 x Pants

product.desc:
Description:
Step back into the 1980s with this retro-inspired coat and pants set, featuring a long-sleeved zippered jacket with vibrant color block designs and high-waisted elastic trousers. Made from lightweight, breathable polyester, this outfit is comfortable, skin-friendly, and durable against fading and wear. Its bright colors and simple yet striking patterns capture the iconic 80s hip-hop style perfectly. Ideal for everyday wear, fitness, sports, hip-hop parties, disco nights, retro events, and halloween. Whether you're working out, running errands, or attending themed, this versatile set adds a stylish vintage touch to any occasion. A perfect gift for vintage fashion lovers!
Item Name: Coat Pants Set
Material: Polyester Fiber
Style: Street Style
Gender: Unisex
Size Type: Regular
Neck Type: Stand Collar
Sleeve Type: Long Sleeve
Tops Length: Regular
Waist Type: Mid-rise
Pants Length: Long Pants
Features: Color Block, Elastic Waist, Drawstring

Notes:
Please refer to our size chart and choose the right size. Due to the light and screen setting difference, the item's color may be slightly different from the pictures.

Package Includes:
1 x Coat
1 x Pants
product.highlights:
Vibrant 1980s retro style with color-blocked zippered jacket and high-waisted trousers, perfect for casual wear and themed parties.
Made from lightweight, breathable polyester for all-day comfort and durability.
Bold, minimalist design with bright colors that retain vibrancy wash after wash.
Versatile outfit ideal for gym sessions, streetwear, retro events, and everyday use.
Features long-sleeved jacket and elastic high-waisted pants for a stylish, comfortable fit.

product.desc:
Description:
Step back into the 1980s with our retro-inspired coat and pants set, featuring a long-sleeved zippered jacket with bold color block designs and high-waisted elastic trousers. Made from lightweight, breathable polyester, this outfit is comfortable, skin-friendly, and resistant to fading and wear. Its bright colors and simple yet striking patterns capture the iconic 80s hip-hop style perfectly. Ideal for everyday wear, fitness, sports, hip-hop parties, disco nights, retro events, and halloween. Whether you're working out, running errands, or attending a themed party, this versatile jumpsuit adds vintage flair to any occasion. A perfect gift for lovers of classic fashion!
Item Name: Coat Pants Set
Material: Polyester Fiber
Style: Street Style
Gender: Unisex
Size Type: Regular
Neck Type: Stand Collar
Sleeve Type: Long Sleeve
Tops Length: Regular
Waist Type: Mid-rise
Pants Length: Long Pants
Features: Color Block, Elastic Waist, Drawstring

Notes:
Please refer to our size chart and choose the right size. Due to the light and screen setting difference, the item's color may be slightly different from the pictures.

Package Includes:
1 x Coat
1 x Pants
product.highlights:
Vibrant 1980s retro style with color-blocked zippered jacket and high-waisted trousers, perfect for casual wear and themed parties.
Made from lightweight, breathable polyester for all-day comfort, durability, and vibrant color retention.
Minimalist design with bold colors captures authentic hip-hop era fashion while offering a timeless look.
Versatile outfit ideal for gym sessions, retro events, streetwear, or everyday wear with a vintage twist.
Features long-sleeved jackets and elastic high-waisted trousers for a comfortable, stylish fit.

Versatile long sleeve design perfect for yoga, running, cycling, gym sessions, and also stylish enough for everyday streetwear.
Breathable, sweat-wicking fabric ensures you stay dry and comfortable while looking chic and confident.
